import os, subprocess, json, shlex, hashlib, time, platform, shutil
from pathlib import Path
candidate=Path.cwd(); baseline=candidate.parent/'enospc-worktree'; scratch=Path(os.environ['KANDELO_AGENT_SCRATCH_DIR']); results=[]
phases=[('baseline-write-node',baseline,['npx','tsx','.context/write-throughput.ts','--allow-pressure-enospc'],baseline),('candidate-write-node',candidate,['npx','tsx','.context/write-throughput.ts'],candidate),('candidate-write-browser',candidate,['npx','playwright','test','test/persistent-write-benchmark.spec.ts','--project=chromium','--workers=1'],candidate/'apps/browser-demos'),('baseline-write-browser',baseline,['npx','playwright','test','test/persistent-write-benchmark.spec.ts','--project=chromium','--workers=1'],baseline/'apps/browser-demos'),('baseline-all-node',baseline,['npx','tsx','benchmarks/run.ts','--rounds=3'],baseline),('candidate-all-node',candidate,['npx','tsx','benchmarks/run.ts','--rounds=3'],candidate),('candidate-all-browser',candidate,['npx','tsx','benchmarks/run.ts','--host=browser','--rounds=3'],candidate),('baseline-all-browser',baseline,['npx','tsx','benchmarks/run.ts','--host=browser','--rounds=3'],baseline)]
for name,root,cmd,cwd in phases:
 print('START '+name,flush=True)
 record=dict(phase=name,root=str(root),command=cmd,commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),start=time.time(),start_monotonic=time.monotonic(),load=os.getloadavg(),platform=platform.platform(),kernel_sha256=hashlib.sha256((root/'local-binaries/source-only-v1/kernel.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
 record['disk_free_bytes']=shutil.disk_usage('/System/Volumes/Data').free
 if record['disk_free_bytes'] < 1024**3:raise RuntimeError('Measurement needs at least 1 GiB of actual host storage headroom')
 custom=root/('.context/write-throughput-node.json' if name.endswith('write-node') else '.context/write-throughput-browser.json') if '-write-' in name else None
 if custom is not None and custom.exists():
  shutil.copy2(custom,scratch/(name+'-previous-output.json'));custom.unlink()
 before=set((root/'benchmarks/results').glob('*.json'))
 command='export WASM_POSIX_XTASK_BIN='+shlex.quote(str(root/'.context/tools/xtask'))+'; cd '+shlex.quote(str(cwd))+'; exec '+shlex.join(cmd)
 if name=='baseline-write-browser':command='export KANDELO_WRITE_BENCH_ALLOW_ENOSPC=1; '+command
 with (scratch/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:record['exit_code']=subprocess.run([str(root/'scripts/dev-shell.sh'),'bash','-c',command],cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
 if custom is not None and custom.exists():
  record['custom_result_file']=str(custom);record['custom_result_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(custom.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 record['finish']=time.time();record['finish_monotonic']=time.monotonic();record['suspend_gap_seconds']=(record['finish']-record['start'])-(record['finish_monotonic']-record['start_monotonic']);record['measurement_suspended']=record['suspend_gap_seconds']>5;record['result_files']=[str(p) for p in set((root/'benchmarks/results').glob('*.json'))-before]
 results.append(record);(scratch/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('DONE '+name+' exit='+str(record['exit_code']),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1 if any(r['exit_code'] or r['measurement_suspended'] for r in results) else 0)
